reference.description: the full PhysioNIRS activation pipeline on the real fnirs_motor recording reproduces the canonical motor-activation signature: HbO up in 18/28 channels significantly (Tapping-Control), HbR down in 25/28, grand-average HbO response peak +0.214 uM, over 28 channels
